info.title: filtrace
info.description: Agent-shaped CLI for analyzing .NET CPU, allocation, thread-time, GC, JIT, and event traces.

commands.name: alloc
commands.description: Rank allocation hotspots by bytes; the shortcut for 'rank --metric alloc'.

options.name: --measure
options.description: Which measure to report: self (the allocating site) or inclusive (its subtree). [Default: Self]

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping the ranking to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of rows to return. [Default: 25]

options.name: --fold
options.description: Extra leaf-frame fold regexes (comma-separated); omit to use the built-in defaults. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Scope to the BenchmarkDotNet measured-workload subtree (preset root); for BDN captures.

commands.name: callers
commands.description: Report the immediate callers of a frame; the drill-down after 'rank' finds a hot frame.

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping the analysis to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of caller rows to return. [Default: 25]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Build-output directory whose embedded PDBs resolve managed frames. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when symbol resolution is below the trusted threshold.

options.name: --process
options.description: Scope to the process tree whose name contains this; omit to auto-scope to the busiest. [Default: @""]

options.name: --all-processes
options.description: Read every process instead of auto-scoping to the busiest (multi-process captures).

options.name: --callees
options.description: Also report the focus frame's immediate callees (a caller/callee view).

commands.name: classify
commands.description:
Summarize CPU self-time by runtime work category - zeroing, copying, GC,
write-barrier, JIT, or other - answering "where did the time go: zeroing memory?
copying strings? in the GC?". Pair with --native-symbols so the native runtime
work resolves; without it the native leaves fall in 'other'.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove the ETLX conversion cache beside a trace to force a rebuild on next read.

commands.name: collect
commands.description:
Record a Windows ETW (.etl) trace of a launched executable, then print the analysis
commands the capture unlocks. Windows-only and requires Administrator; for an
EventPipe (.nettrace) capture use dotnet-trace (cross-platform).

options.name: --launch
options.description: Path to the executable to launch and trace (the built app, never 'dotnet run'). [Required]

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the .etl file to write. [Required]

options.name: --metric
options.description: What to tune the capture for: cpu (default) or threadtime (adds context switches for wall-clock time). [Default: @"cpu"]

options.name: --launch-args
options.description: Arguments passed to the launched executable, as one command-line string. [Default: @""]

options.name: --cpu-ms
options.description: CPU sample interval in milliseconds. [Default: 1]

options.name: --duration
options.description: Optional cap on capture length in seconds; 0 (default) captures until the process exits. [Default: 0]

options.name: --max-size-mb
options.description: Optional cap on the capture's on-disk size in megabytes; 0 (default) writes an unbounded file. When set, a circular buffer keeps the last N MB - size it to hold the run, since a full ring overwrites the oldest events and can drop early JIT method names. [Default: 0]

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Build the ETLX conversion cache up front so the first analysis query is fast.

commands.name: cpu
commands.description: Rank CPU-time hotspots; the shortcut for 'rank --metric cpu'.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two traces and report what got slower or faster between them.

options.name: --measure
options.description: Which measure to compare: self (leaf time, helpers folded) or inclusive. [Default: Self]

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping both rankings to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of changed rows to return. [Default: 25]

options.name: --fold
options.description: Extra leaf-frame fold regexes (comma-separated); omit to use the built-in defaults. [Default: null]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Build-output directory whose embedded PDBs resolve managed frames. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when either trace's symbol resolution is below the trusted threshold.

commands.name: diskio
commands.description: Report physical disk I/O by file: bytes read and written to each file, and disk service time.

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of per-file rows to show, ranked by disk time. [Default: 25]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

commands.name: events
commands.description: Query the trace's raw events by name, with paging and a per-event payload cap.

options.name: --name
options.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against provider/event; omit to match every event. [Default: @""]

options.name: --skip
options.description: Number of matches to skip, for paging. [Default: 0]

options.name: --take
options.description: Maximum number of matches to return on this page. [Default: 50]

options.name: --max-payload
options.description: Per-event payload character cap; 0 omits payloads. [Default: 200]

options.name: --payload
options.description: Keep only events whose payload values contain this (case-insensitive); omit for no payload filter. [Default: @""]

options.name: --pid
options.description: Keep only events from this process id; omit for every process. [Default: -1]

options.name: --tid
options.description: Keep only events on this thread id; omit for every thread. [Default: -1]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Scope to the BenchmarkDotNet measured-workload subtree (preset root); for BDN captures.

commands.description: Export a trace to a flame-graph file for speedscope or chrome://tracing.

commands.description:
List the processes in a trace, ranked by CPU-sample weight, so a multi-process

Report thread-pool worker-thread adjustments: how often the pool grew, and how
often because it detected starvation (the classic sync-over-async hang signal).

commands.name: timeline
commands.description: Correlate what a trace was doing over time: per-bucket GC, CPU, exception, allocation, and JIT activity.

options.name: --lanes
options.description: Comma-separated lanes to include: gc, cpu, exceptions, alloc, jit; omit for every lane. [Default: @""]

options.name: --buckets
options.description: Number of equal time buckets to divide the window into (clamped to 5-200). [Default: 50]

options.name: --time
options.description: Scope to a time window 'start,end' in ms relative to the trace start; either bound may be omitted (e.g. 1000,5000 or 1000, or ,5000). [Default: @""]

options.name: --process
options.description: Scope a multi-process .etl to the tree whose name contains this; omit to auto-scope to the busiest. [Default: @""]

options.name: --all-processes

options.name: --format

commands.name: tree
commands.description: Show the top-down call tree, following the hot path from the root into its callees.

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping the tree to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: Maximum number of frame levels to expand below the root. [Default: 10]

options.name: --min-pct
options.description: Minimum share of the scoped total (percent) a node must have to appear; 0 shows all. [Default: 1]

options.name: --fold
options.description: Extra leaf-frame fold regexes (comma-separated); omit to use the built-in defaults. [Default: null]
